title: sphenostigma longispatha

It is a tropical evergreen tree native to the Western Ghats in India and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sphenostigma longispatha include its potential to aid in weight loss, improve digestion, and lower cholesterol levels due to its high content of Garcinol, a polyphenol with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sphenostigma longispatha include anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
